name: Pietro Lokosh
description: A sub-lieutenant in Marchesa's organization whom Ervos names as a target for extortion.

timeline.summary: Ervos explains the plan to corrupt a trusted lieutenant such as Pietro Lokosh, and Marchesa names him before Ervos does.

relations.note: Pietro is one of Marchesa's sub-lieutenants.
relations.quote: As one of your sub-lieutenants, Pietro Lokosh would be the sort of person I would use.

pages_say.description: A sub-lieutenant in Marchesa's organization whom Ervos names as a target for extortion.
